title: Serial-In Parallel-Out Shift Register
text: Discrete-time serial-in, parallel-out shift register, 1 input, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Number of samples} sets the number of input samples and {Initial condition} sets the initial value of the input sample. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of samples
params.values: Number of input samples 4 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Initial condition
params.values: Initial value of the input sample 0 (default) | real number
